title: Bottom-page cycles-to-homology compatibility
statement: Let C be abelian, Y an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object, E its standard E2 spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence], and m_(p,r) the explicit bottom-page maps [def-sc-spectral-object-bottom-page-map]. For every natural p and integer r>=2, the following equality of maps from the cycles at (p,0) on page r to H_Y^p(bottom,top) holds: iCycles_(p,0) followed by m_(p,r) equals homologyPi_(p,0), followed by the standard page homology isomorphism E_r.homology(p,0) ~= E_(r+1)^(p,0), followed by m_(p,r+1).

source.document: Stacks Project, Homology and Derived Categories; Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.SpectralObject

proof.text: Set a=2-r and c=r-1. Rewrite the standard spectral-object homology isomorphism using spectralSequence_iso. Its homology data have kernel object E^p(a-1,0,1,c), included by changing a-1 to a and projected by changing c to c+1. The canonical cycles isomorphisms therefore reduce the desired square to equality of two maps out of this kernel object. This is exactly spectralSequenceHomologyData_left_i and spectralSequenceHomologyData_left_π, together with cyclesIso_hom_comp_i and homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom.

Expand the bottom-page maps. Cancel the page comparison and its inverse. Apply map_ιE: on the left the opcycles map is the identity; on the right it is the map changing c to c+1. Then opcyclesMap_fromOpcycles replaces the latter followed by fromOpcycles at c+1 with fromOpcycles at c followed by H^p(0,c)->H^p(0,c+1).

Functoriality of H gives the commuting square between H^p(bottom,c), H^p(0,c), H^p(bottom,c+1), H^p(0,c+1). Both vertical maps are invertible by first-quadrant vanishing in (bottom,0), in degrees p and p+1. Move these inverses across the square. The two maps from H^p(bottom,c) to H^p(bottom,top) agree by functoriality; thus the claimed square commutes. This argument applies unchanged at p=0 and r=2.

lean.statement:
theorem bottomPageMap_compatibility
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (Y : SpectralObject C EInt) [Y.IsFirstQuadrant]
    (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).iCycles (p, 0) ≫ Y.bottomPageMap p r hr =
      (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).homologyπ (p, 0) ≫
        (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.iso r (r + 1) (p, 0) rfl hr).hom ≫
          Y.bottomPageMap p (r + 1) (by omega)
